messages:
Sana (People Ops): quick heads-up — we've rolled out two admin changes that go into effect next Monday (local timezone). pls skim and flag questions. :wave:

Sana (People Ops): 1) Travel reimbursement revisions: per-diem limits by region (see table). No receipts needed under per-diem. Receipts still required for lodging, airfare, and taxis over $75.

Sana (People Ops): 2) PTO rollover tweak: starting 2026 fiscal year, employees may carry over up to 5 unused days (40 hours) into the next year. Any excess will auto-convert to the company's Leave Bank at 0.75x value for emergency use.

Raj (Finance): quick note — per-diem bands: US $75/day, EU €65/day, APAC local equivalent (country page). We'll update Concur rules so expense reports auto-categorize.

Tina (People Ops): added: mandatory pre-travel safety briefing for travel to countries on the APAC watchlist; it's a 10min self-paced module in LMS. If you're traveling to one of those countries, you must complete it 48h before departure.

Marta (CTO): thanks — two requests: (1) can we get examples of what converts to Leave Bank? (2) for critical on-call travel, can we make an exception to the 48h rule?

Sana (People Ops): good q. examples: unused PTO beyond 40h, documented bereavement top-ups (rare), and discretionary company closure credits. For on-call travel exceptions, teams can request an expedited waiver via the travel-bot with manager + eng-lead approval.

travel-bot: waiver request template: ``/travel-waiver <employee> <dates> <reason> <manager-approval-yes/no>`` — use this in #travel-ops. Bot will route to Finance + People Ops automatically. :gear:

Raj (Finance): FYI reimbursements for meals over per-diem will need itemized receipts and manager sign-off. We'll monitor for misuse and reach out if trends appear.

Tina (People Ops): policy doc (updated) -> https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/travel-and-leave (linkable in file). We'll host an AMA Friday 9am PT in #people-ops for questions. :calendar:

Sana (People Ops): TL;DR: per-diem clarified, receipts rules tightened, PTO rollover capped at 5 days (40h) and excess moves to Leave Bank, APAC safety module + 48h rule, waiver via travel-bot for urgent cases.

Marta (CTO): :thumbsup: appreciate the clarity.

Sana (People Ops): thanks — if you handle travel bookings for others (exec assistants, managed accounts), please forward this thread and ensure travelers complete the LMS module where applicable.

Tina (People Ops): ping me or @Sana if you need the manager approval template for expense exceptions.

Sana (People Ops): closing note — these updates are intended to reduce manual ticketing, speed reimbursements, and make emergency leave funds easier to access. We'll revisit after Q1 2026 metrics. :bar_chart:
